_doc: Random events fire on the '?' days of the week. Effect types: rating, budget, fatigue, ltf, away, spawn_task, modifier, relic, consumable, chance, flag, fatigue_floor. 'who'/'pick' choose analysts: on_shift, all, target, best_skill (with skill), random, least_fatigued, most_fatigued.

title: The Ministry wants a briefing
text: The Minister's office has asked for an in-person briefing on recent seismic activity. Today.

options.label: Send your best communicator
options.hint: Best Comms analyst on shift away for 3 h. Trust +6.

options.label: Send slides instead
options.hint: Adds a 'Prepare ministry briefing' task. Trust +2.

title: School group at reception
text: A Year 12 science class has turned up for a tour of the monitoring centre. Someone forgot to put it in the calendar.

options.label: Give them the tour
options.hint: A random analyst on shift is away for 1.5 h. Trust +3. 40% chance a keen graduate applies.

effects.success_text: One of the students asks how to become a GHA. Look out for them in the shop.

title: Power cut
text: The building has lost mains power. The UPS is holding, but the secondary systems are sluggish.

title: Phantom events
text: The automatic system is detecting earthquakes that don't exist. Analysts keep tripping over them.

options.label: Investigate now
options.hint: Adds a Systems task: 'Investigate phantom events'.

title: Vendor offers a beta tool
text: A software vendor offers their shiny new beta tool for free. What could go wrong?

options.label: Accept the beta
options.hint: Gain a random common or uncommon tool. 50% chance it crashes right away.

title: Journalist on the phone
text: A national radio show wants someone on air in an hour to talk about recent quakes.

options.label: Do the interview
options.hint: Adds a Comms task 'Media interview'. Trust +4.

title: Someone brought cake
text: There is a chocolate cake in the kitchen with a note: 'For the night crew. And the day crew. Just share it.'

title: Storm takes out stations
text: A storm front has knocked several remote stations offline.

title: Research team needs a hand
text: A research group will pay for an analyst's time to help relocate an old earthquake sequence.

options.label: Lend them someone
options.hint: Least tired analyst on shift away for 3 h. +$4k.

title: Unspent equipment budget
text: Finance found some unspent equipment budget. Use it or lose it before the end of the month.

title: Unrest at Whakaari
text: Gas output and tremor have spiked at the island volcano. The volcanologists want everything you've got.

options.label: Full assessment
options.hint: Adds 'Volcanic unrest assessment' and 'Volcano webcam review'. Trust +2.

title: Mandatory software update
text: IT says the analysis software needs an update. It will be slow while it installs, but faster afterwards.

options.label: Update now
options.hint: Everything 20% slower for 4 h, then earthquake tasks 10% faster for 3 days.

title: Air conditioning broken
text: The ops room is getting very warm.

title: Viral 'prediction' post
text: A post claiming a big quake is coming this weekend has gone viral. Enquiries are piling up.

options.label: Publish a debunk
options.hint: Adds a Comms task 'Debunk viral post'. Trust +3.

title: Internal award nomination
text: The centre has been nominated for an internal 'Science Impact' award.

title: Volunteer for overtime
text: One of your off-duty analysts offers to come in for a few hours to help clear the backlog.

options.label: Gratefully accept
options.hint: Gain a free 'Focus Hour' supply. A random off-duty analyst: long-term fatigue +4.

title: Fire drill
text: The fire wardens are clearing the building for a drill, and they mean everyone, ops room included.

options.label: Everyone out
options.hint: Everyone on shift is away for 30 minutes.

options.label: Leave one analyst at the desks
options.hint: A random analyst on shift is away for 30 minutes. Trust -1 (the wardens complain).

title: The coffee machine has died
text: A sad gurgle, a puff of steam, and the ops room coffee machine is no more.

title: ShakeOut drill day
text: It's the national earthquake drill, and the comms team wants the monitoring centre front and centre.

options.label: Go all in
options.hint: Adds a Comms task 'ShakeOut drill comms'. Trust +4.

title: Research data request
text: A university group wants a big waveform and catalogue extract for a paper, and will acknowledge the centre.

options.label: Pull the data
options.hint: Adds a Systems task 'Research data request'. +$2k, trust +1.

options.label: Point them at the public data

title: Call from a Pacific partner
text: A partner agency in the Pacific is struggling to locate a regional quake and asks for help.

options.label: Lend a hand
options.hint: Adds a Seismic task 'Help a Pacific partner'. Trust +3.

title: Delegation visit
text: An overseas delegation is touring the centre this afternoon and wants to meet the analysts.

options.label: Roll out the red carpet
options.hint: Best Comms analyst on shift away for 2 h. Trust +5.

options.label: A quick wave from the doorway

title: Critical security patch
text: IT needs the processing servers patched. They can do it right now, or leave it with you.

options.label: We'll do it ourselves later
options.hint: Adds a Systems task 'Patch the processing servers'.

title: Pager glitch
text: The paging system is dropping messages. Duty officers might not get a page first time.

options.label: Fall back to the phone tree
options.hint: Paging duty officers takes 60% more work for 48 h.

title: Station vandalised
text: Someone has broken into a remote seismic site and walked off with the solar panels.

options.label: Organise repairs now
options.hint: Adds 'Coordinate station repair' and 'Seismic station outage'.

options.label: Leave it until next week
options.hint: Earthquake tasks have 15% more errors for 3 days (one station short).

title: Team lunch
text: Someone suggests a shared lunch in the ops room to lift spirits after a hard week.

options.label: Shout everyone lunch
options.hint: Costs $1k. Everyone on shift: fatigue -10, long-term fatigue -3.

title: Wellbeing check-in
text: HR offers a wellbeing session for whoever on shift looks the most worn out.

options.label: Send them along
options.hint: Most tired analyst on shift: long-term fatigue -8, away for 1 h.

title: An old colleague offers a hand
text: A former analyst, now freelancing, offers to work the rest of this shift for a fee.

options.label: Hire them for the shift
options.hint: Costs $2k. A skilled contractor joins until the end of the shift.

title: Aftershock forecast request
text: Emergency management want an updated aftershock forecast for recent activity, by this afternoon.

options.label: Prepare it
options.hint: Adds a Seismic task 'Update aftershock forecast'. Trust +3.
